text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a breeze of heat wafting by one
morning at summer camp. It's
still pretty
early, but Zephyr's nowhere to be found at
the lodge.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I knew I felt a southerly wind
brewing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I sensed a refreshing new wind about
to rise with the sun, so I got
curious where
it might start.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then just now, the sea breeze finally
started moving inland. Almost as
though it
had come from... from you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, that'd make about as much sense as a
summer snowstorm. Putting
that silliness
aside, let's have another wonderful
training session
today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And now... like a thunderous gale!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Panting...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I must continue to ride this
current, taking it up to soar the
high
heav...ens...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...The cool breeze is here again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? If I may, could I make a
request?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If there's no breeze to carry you away this
evening, would you
accompany me to wait
for the wind?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's something... something I'd like to
verify.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's worth scheduling a commitment, the
wind brewing has to be
something big. If I
could feel it, I'm sure it would push me
closer to
understanding Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a relief, like the early autumn
breeze in late summer. I'll
see you again
tonight, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr leads me from the lodge, down a
nearby street.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It seems the wind has settled down for the
evening... but the quiet lull
here is a nice
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a content look on her face,
despite the distinct lack of wind.
With how
cloudy it is, we can't even see the stars.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. We're waiting for the wind, after
all. It'll take some time for
the evening lull
to pass and the night breeze to come in.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But I don't imagine it will be too long. Soon enough, we'll be greeted by the same wind we felt this morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Morning, Zephyr. Were you out on a walk?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I sensed a refreshing new wind about
to rise with the sun, so I got
curious where
it might start.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then just now, the sea breeze finally
started moving inland. Almost as
though it
had come from... from you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sea breeze flows from the shore by
day, then stops when the air
cools at night.
If we wait here, it should flow back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So the wind blows from the sea by day, and to the sea by night? And if we wait here now, the current from this morning will pass us on its way back to the waves...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I want to see it to be sure... I need to know
where the clear breeze I
felt came from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sounds so determined... so I perk up
my senses and strain for the
slightest hint
of—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hehe, there goes Hankey. What a
coincidence to see you
gliding by.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, but I've just spotted Sir Spectacles.
This area must have some
gentle,
welcoming winds to attract a bird like him.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She smiles, casting her gaze to "Sir
Spectacles." I look around the
dark foliage
blindly until a low hoot leads me to an
owl.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you look that way, Flitter is flapping
along on her leathery wings.
Hehe, it's like
everyone's out flying around in a waltz.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Hahh...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is a lovely patch of woods... It reminds
me of the sun-driven
winds back home.
Relaxing into calm, clear air... cool and
pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind... Now you mention it, the air is still... And yet...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's so comfortable, like the gentle breeze
I felt before...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. I think I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'd been thinking it peculiar—wondering
why it always felt like... like
there was a
gentle breeze encouraging me on.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And I finally figured out why this morning.
The air was suffocatingly
still when I
woke—no fresh wind to clear the chill in
my heart. But
then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind came running for me. A gentle
current sailing along the
morning
tide—stirred by your voice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And I realized... maybe the gentle breeze I
keep feeling is following
you. It was just an
idle thought, but now...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even though there's no wind, I still feel that soft breeze in my heart. You are the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You are the breath of fresh air, the comforting wind at my back... They're all you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always dreamed of being free as the
wind, and generally prefers
not to tie
herself down with other people... So
hearing that she enjoys
my presence... I
just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm determined. I'll be the wind in her
sails—the gentle gust of
encouragement
she believes I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: How kind of you, Trainer. Now, let us soar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We rush ahead with the wind, riding it all
the way to the sea. The gust
must have
cleared out the clouds, because the waves
are glittering
with starlight.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How gently the wind danced... I felt its
comforting embrace closer
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Do you think I'll be able to feel it again
someday?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Together... with you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She nods softly, and we spend some time
stargazing, silently enjoying
the tranquil
sea breeze.
